boot_sequence: verify current research-repository main and this bootstrap
refresh current product main and task-relevant receipts/code
execute the trigger through the Clay Machine target and persist bounded evidence
source_of_truth_order: verified current product/research repository bytes and runtime/effect receipts

fallback: If current owner/program/repository verification fails, mark degraded state, preserve the Clay Machine target, and do not invent completion or execution state.
